name: @fluentui/react-tailwind-theme
description: Shared Tailwind v4 theme layer for the CSS Modules styling migration: cascade layer order, custom variants, the base-scale spacing bridge, and the generated Fluent token registration (css/tokens.css). Fluent tokens stay runtime CSS custom properties written by FluentProvider; `@theme inline` only gives them utility names, so utilities compile to direct var(--token) references and per-provider theming is unchanged.
